name: Polycurse Dagger

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Polycurse
effects.tooltip: Polycurse : This weapon is enchanted with many diverse curses. On a critical hit an enemy may be hit with one of these effects at random: Blindness , Exhaustion , Bestow Curse , or Enervation .

effects.name: Sneak Attack Bonus
effects.tooltip: Sneak Attack Bonus +3 : Provides a +3 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +5 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.

effects.name: Deception
effects.tooltip: Deception : This weapon is hard to focus upon and thus provides a +3 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, Deception weapons have a small chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.

effects.name: Curse Vector
effects.tooltip: Curse Vector : This item is a carrier of curses. It can apply them to your foes, but also to you- when you are damaged there is a small chance that you will have a Bestow Curse cast on you.

effects.name: Corrosive Salt
effects.tooltip: Corrosive Salt : This weapon stores a caustic, insatiable power deep within. When this weapon is used, this power can come to the surface in the form of a noxious, corrosive salt that dissolves all substances.

flavor_text: An unusually large dagger turned vile and unpredictable after being wielded by the creatures of Xoriat. Enemies cut by the dagger's blade are subject to a wide array of debilitating curses.
tips: You can remove the Curse Vector penalty with a Sustaining Symbiont .
